svg.title: The Woman at the Well
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 4 panels. Panel 1 (John 4:6-7): Jesus sits tired beside the stone rim of Jacob's well; a Samaritan woman walks up carrying a water jar. Caption: "Noon at a well in Samaria. Jesus is tired." Jesus says: "Give me a drink." Panel 2 (John 4:11): The woman, jar in hand, speaks to Jesus; above her head a thought cloud shows a deep hole cut through rock to water far below. The woman pictures a deep hole in the rock, labelled "a deep hole". The woman says: "You have nothing to draw water with, and the well is deep." Panel 3 (John 4:14): Jesus, seated, answers; above His head a thought cloud shows water rising out of the rock on its own and running over. Jesus pictures a spring rising out of the rock, labelled "a spring". Jesus says: "The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water." Panel 4 (John 4:28-29): The woman's water jar stands on the ground by the well where she left it, and she hurries away toward the town. Caption: "She leaves her jar and runs to tell the town." The woman says: "Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?" The point: Jesus gives a spring that never runs dry: His Holy Spirit, inside anyone who asks Him (John 4:10, 14; 7:39).
svg.text: A deep hole, a spring, and the One who gives it
Jesus gives a spring that never runs dry: His Holy
Spirit, inside anyone who asks Him (John 4:10, 14; 7:39).
Each panel names its verses; every word in a bubble is the ESV's.
